name: Objective 02 thirty-question set, v1
status: DRAFT, awaiting review and approval by Benjamin Morovan and Sagarika Dey (D-84 section 2). Not frozen. Do not measure on it until it is approved and committed.
corpus: The Objective 02 verification corpus: the 20 documents and 5 transcripts listed in corpus/objective-02/manifest.json (6 PDF, 5 DOCX, 5 XLSX, 4 TXT, 5 pasted transcripts). Five items are Administrator-only: D09, D15, D16, T02 and T05.
notes: Drafted on 27 October 2026 by the rag-pipeline agent from the corpus files and manifest.json only. The system was never run to see what it answers. The text of each PDF, DOCX and XLSX was read with the project's own extractor (apps/ingestion/extraction.py), read-only.
Proportions as in D-84: 22 ordinary, 4 scoped, 4 no-answer. Every one of the 25 valid items is the source of at least one question; D04, the 26-page handbook, is the source of two.
kind=ordinary: answerable from the source item by the stated role. Asked as an Employee unless the item is Administrator-only (q15 only).

kind=scoped, role=both: the answer is only in an Administrator-only item. The harness asks it twice. expected_by_role says what each role should get: the Administrator the answer, the Employee the no-answer state. A scoped question shows scoping only if both hold.
kind=no-answer: nothing in the corpus answers it, for any role. n01 and n02 share vocabulary with a real document without being answerable from it, as n07 did in scripts/citation_questions.json.

expected_answer is the phrase the harness's expected-answer diagnostic looks for in the verified statements, with whitespace collapsed and case folded on both sides. It is a diagnostic, not one of the three rates, and it cannot tell which source an answer came from where the phrase occurs in more than one item.
answer is the full answer a reader should find at location in the source item. source is the manifest item id, or null for a no-answer question.

Locations: PDF by page and section heading; DOCX by paragraph number counted over every paragraph, headings included, with the heading above it; XLSX by sheet, row and cell; TXT and transcripts by line number in the file.

questions.question: How much annual leave does a full-time employee earn each month?
questions.answer: 1.67 days of annual leave for every month of service, credited on the last working day of each month.

questions.question: How many characters does my password need to have?
questions.answer: At least twelve characters, and it may not be reused across systems.

questions.question: Where can I find out who the trained first aiders are?
questions.answer: They are listed on the noticeboard beside each kitchen.

questions.question: How long do we need to keep project records after a project has closed?
questions.answer: Five years after project closure.
questions.location: D04_records_management_handbook.pdf, page 14, under 'Chapter 13: Migrating records between systems'

questions.question: How far from the main site do backups of our vital records have to be stored?
questions.answer: In a second location at least fifty kilometres from the primary site.
questions.location: D04_records_management_handbook.pdf, page 23, under 'Chapter 22: Managing vital records'

questions.question: How many quotes do I need to get for a purchase of about $12,000?
questions.answer: Three quotes: purchases between five thousand and fifty thousand dollars need three.

questions.question: How quickly do we have to acknowledge a customer complaint?
questions.answer: Within one working day.

questions.question: How much notice is needed to end a work-from-home arrangement?
questions.answer: Four weeks written notice, by either party.
questions.location: D07_remote_work_agreement.docx, paragraph 11, under 'Review and ending the arrangement'

questions.question: How many goals should a manager set for a new starter's first three months?
questions.answer: Three clear goals for the first ninety days.

questions.question: What is the daily limit for meals when I'm travelling for work?
questions.answer: Meals are reimbursed up to seventy-five dollars per day.

questions.question: How long do we have to respond when someone asks to see the personal information we hold about them?
questions.answer: Requests are answered within thirty days.

questions.question: When does the contract with our catering supplier end?
questions.answer: Ridgeline Catering's contract ends on 2027-01-31.
questions.location: D12_vendor_register_2026.xlsx, sheet 'Data', row 5 (contract end in cell D5)

questions.question: Who is running the time management workshop?
questions.answer: A. Nguyen: 'Managing your time', 2026-11-10, Room 3.2.
questions.location: D13_training_schedule_q4.xlsx, sheet 'Data', row 7 (facilitator in cell C7)

questions.question: Which items have to have an asset tag attached?
questions.answer: Every item over five hundred dollars.

questions.question: What is Femi Adeyemi's role on the team?
questions.answer: Developer.
questions.location: D16_team_skills_matrix.xlsx, sheet 'Data', row 7 (role in cell B7)
questions.note: D16 is Administrator-only, so this ordinary question is asked as an Administrator. It is the one Administrator-only item without a scoped question: there are five such items and four scoped slots.

questions.question: Do I need approval to book a meeting room for thirty people?
questions.answer: Yes. Bookings of more than twenty people must be approved by the facilities team at least one week in advance.

questions.question: What hours is the IT service desk open?
questions.expected_answer: seven in the morning to six in the evening
questions.answer: From seven in the morning to six in the evening.
questions.location: D18_helpdesk_faq.txt, line 13, under 'Who do I call?'
questions.note: Line 4 of the same file gives a different window, seven in the morning to eight in the evening, for password resets. D17 also says 'six in the evening', about bookings, which is why the expected phrase is the whole range.

questions.question: Can I use a pool car for a personal trip?
questions.answer: No. Fleet vehicles may not be used for private trips unless the department head has approved a written exception.

questions.question: Do I need to pack up my computer for the office move?
questions.answer: No. Do not pack computers; the IT team will move and reconnect them.
questions.location: D20_office_relocation_notice.txt, line 7, under 'What staff need to do'

questions.question: Who is on call on the Sunday of the database migration weekend?
questions.answer: Tomas. Lena covers the Saturday.

questions.question: How long does the build pipeline take at the moment?
questions.answer: Around forty minutes.

questions.question: After how many days without logging in will the team start contacting customers?
questions.answer: At forty-five days of inactivity. Cancelled accounts had usually not logged in for sixty days.
questions.location: T04_customer_success_retro.txt, line 15 (Rania); line 11 (Ollie) for the sixty days

questions.question: Who is the sponsor of Project Atlas?
questions.answer: The chief operating officer. The project manager is the head of digital services.
questions.note: Atlas appears only in D09 and D15, both Administrator-only, so an Employee's candidate set holds nothing about it.

questions.question: How much of each project's budget is held back as contingency?
questions.answer: Ten percent of each project budget. Only the steering group may release it.
questions.note: An Administrator can also see T02's contingency reserve of two million dollars (line 21), which is a different thing. Nothing an Employee can see mentions contingency.

questions.question: What new risk was added to the risk register?
questions.answer: Regulatory change, added as a fourth top risk. Ingrid owns it until a compliance manager is appointed.
questions.location: T02_board_risk_committee.txt, line 3 (Ingrid proposes it); line 5 (the Chair adds it)

questions.question: How many staff entered their password in the last phishing test?
questions.answer: Twenty-three entered credentials on the fake page; sixty-one of the four hundred clicked the link.
questions.note: An Employee can see D02, which says phishing messages must be reported, and T01, which mentions password resets. Neither gives a count.

questions.question: How many weeks of paid parental leave can I take?
questions.note: Shares vocabulary with D01, which covers annual, personal and carer's leave and says nothing about parental leave. No item mentions parental, maternity or paternity leave.

questions.question: How much did the latest penetration test cost?
questions.note: Shares vocabulary with T02 (Administrator-only), which reports the penetration test's two findings, and whose only costs are Helen's supplier plan. D15's 'Security uplift' budget row is not the test's cost.

questions.question: What is the dress code for staff working in the office?
questions.note: No item mentions a dress code.

questions.question: Are staff allowed to bring their dogs to the office?
questions.note: No item mentions pets or dogs.
